status: Models pinned (config/model_registry.json + price_vector.json, D22/D24); freeze at preregistration tag

design.team_rule: model-homogeneous: all 3 agents in a run use the SAME model; only persona/role prompts differ
design.solo_persona: Culture_5 (best single persona per Doing More with Less)

families.note: strip reasoning traces before judging if extended thinking enabled
strip reasoning traces before judging (Paper 2 comparability caveat); preview risk - preregistered fallback gemini-2.5-pro

fallback_family.note: used only if one of the 5 families is inaccessible

cells._problems: factorial cells run on the 30 main problems (6 domains x 5); special arms A5-A8 run on the original 15 only (mechanism arms need no domain breadth)

F-T-N.family_rule: PREREGISTERED: strongest Western frontier by F-S-N Novelty + Kimi V3

consistency_slice.rule: the single pre-registered special-arm cheap family runs 5 reps (instead of 3) in its four cheap cells C-S-N/C-S-P/C-T-N/C-T-P, 30 problems
consistency_slice.purpose: reliable within-cell SD for the Consistency DV (SD from n=3 has ~52% sampling error; n=5 ~38%); mean-effect inference uses 3 reps everywhere per Westfall-Kenny-Judd stimulus-sampling power logic

frontier_cost_matched_A6.selection_rule: PREREGISTERED: the frontier model with the highest mean Novelty in F-S-N becomes the A6 cost-matched baseline; token budget derived from pooled C-T-P median cost

designer_smart_eastern.note: Kimi V3 designs pipeline per problem; every design output archived in pipelines/adaptive_A7/; tokens counted in cost, amortized over 5 reps

judges.note: family disjoint from generators; replaces Gemini which moved to the generator pool

tiers.judge_disjointness_rule: generator families = {openai, anthropic, google, moonshot, alibaba}; judge families = {mistral, zhipu, meta} — no overlap

generation.temperature_note: D27 (2026-07-31): pre-registered 0.7 replaced by 1 uniformly — OpenAI gpt-5.6 and Moonshot kimi APIs enforce temperature=1 (400 otherwise); uniform value preserves cross-family ceteris paribus
generation.max_tokens_note: D28 (2026-07-31): pre-registered 2048 replaced by 8192 uniformly — kimi hidden reasoning counts against the completion budget and exhausted 2048 in team cells, returning empty visible output; cap is unobservable to models, token usage remains the cost DV

judging.ensemble_level: scores only: solution ensemble score = mean of 9 judge scores
judging.blinding: solutions stripped of arm identifiers, randomized order; Paper 1 verbatim blinding instruction reused
judging.judge_prompts_frozen: 3 proven variants verbatim; never redesigned (Paper 1 optimization attempts collapsed kappa)
judging.human_validation: NONE - author decision D26 (2026-07-30): no human rater panel; validity via verbatim Papers 1-2 instrument, Fleiss kappa + ICC(2,k) on all solutions, leave-one-judge-out, judge-family disjointness; stated as limitation

units: solution-level ensemble score (effect sizes, comparable to Papers 1-2)
judge-level mixed model with solution+judge+problem+family random effects (primary inference; fixes Paper 2 pseudo-replication)
analysis.secondary_dv_consistency: within-cell SD of Novelty across repetitions
analysis.inherited_stack: stats_with_anlysis.py adapted: bootstrap d CI 5000 seed 42, Welch t, FDR-BH, Type II ANOVA + partial eta2, Rouder BF + exact JZS BF (pingouin), TTestIndPower, IsolationForest 0.1, 80/20 split by problem, leave-one-out (judge/family), mean-vs-median, EGR economics
analysis.oracle_portfolio: per-problem best-cell oracle router upper bound vs A7 adaptive (Paper 4 +42.9% union precedent)
analysis.h2_domain_moderator: CONFIRMATORY with 6 domains x 5 problems: domain as fixed moderator in the mixed model (Structure x Domain interaction); enabled by the domain-stratified 30-problem set
analysis.consistency_dv_scope: tested only within the 5-rep consistency-slice family; 3-rep SDs reported descriptively
analysis.irr: Fleiss kappa AND ICC(2,k) per dimension on ALL solutions

execution_resilience.ledger: runs/ledger.csv — full randomized interleaved run list committed at preregistration (seed 42)
execution_resilience.idempotent_resume: scan ledger, skip DONE, requeue FAILED_RETRYABLE; credit outage or disconnect leaves runs PENDING and execution resumes when service returns
execution_resilience.error_handling: failed generations re-run, never scored (parsed_ok gate); fixes Paper 4 silent budget burn

problems.domain_map: data/problems/domain_map.json (30 main problems, 6 domains x 5; original-15 tags PENDING author confirmation)
problems.fresh_control: data/problems/fresh_business_cases_10.json (out-of-sample post-cutoff robustness set, NOT in the domain grid)
problems.special_arms_subset: A5-A8 run on the original 15 problems only

economic_dv: T-EGR = (Novelty_cell / Novelty_F-S-N) / (Cost_cell / Cost_F-S-N); cost recomputed as tokens x config/price_vector.json (D23), never stored as observed dollars

cost_accounting.token_efficiency_robustness: Novelty per 1K output tokens, tokenizer caveat stated

exploratory_gates.decision: D31 (2026-07-31): pre-registered sequential gate protocol; gates allocate exploratory budget only, confirmatory factorial runs in full regardless
exploratory_gates.interpretation: futility/feasibility only; pilot results never reported as effect evidence (Albers & Lakens 2018); every executed arm reported regardless of outcome; H4/H5 conditional on their arm's gate

gates.G0: all arms: empty-output rate <=5% per cell; judge Fleiss kappa >=0.40; per-cell cost <=1.5x budget envelope; else fix and re-pilot
gates.G-A5: C-T-P completion >=95% AND Critic verdict machine-parseable >=90%; else drop A5, H4 not testable
gates.G-A6: token ledger exact AND F-S-N Novelty top model stable under leave-one-rep-out; else +2 reps then drop if unstable
gates.G-A7: >=90% of designed pipelines schema-valid and executable without manual repair on 5 pilot problems; one archived designer-prompt revision permitted, re-gate once, then drop
gates.G-A7P: G-A7 passed AND (confirmatory Persona |d|>=0.20 OR A7 mean Novelty >= C-T-N minus SESOI); else drop, Design x Persona not estimated
gates.G-A8: confirmatory Persona main effect |d|>=0.20; else drop A8, H5 not testable

exploratory_gates.a7_refinements: D30: A7 executes without personas; design-variance probe = 5 problems x 3 temp-1 designs x 1 execution; A7-P = designer also staffs roles from the frozen persona pool only; designer/probe/staffing tokens charged to arm cost
